page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.re6.52xlarge is an x86_64 memory-optimized instance operating on a KVM hypervisor. The server features 208 dedicated virtual CPUs powered by Intel Xeon 8269CL processors, combined with 3072.0 GB of system memory. This hardware configuration provides approximately 14.77 GB of RAM per vCPU, establishing a high memory-to-vCPU allocation ratio suitable for footprint-heavy applications.

Network performance is supported by a 32 Gbps baseline network bandwidth interface. The instance includes no integrated local storage and no GPU acceleration hardware. Storage requirements must be satisfied through external network-attached block devices. The resource balance heavily emphasizes RAM density per vCPU rather than local ephemeral storage or graphics accelerators.

The hardware capabilities of this instance suit memory-intensive enterprise tasks. Primary workload applications include large-scale in-memory databases, high-capacity distributed caching systems, enterprise resource planning platforms, and big data analytical pipelines that require extensive RAM allocation without reliance on local NVMe disk arrays.
